html: סוד ( √ of foll.; perhaps kindred with יסד (cf. יסד Niph.), v. Köii. 1, 49; Ecclus 42:12 Hithp.הִסְתַּוֵּיד (margin הסתיד) converse, is perhaps denom.; Syriac ܣܘܳܕܳܐ, ܣܽܘܘܳܕ friendly, confidential speech, ὁμιλία, ܐܶܣܬܰܘܰܕ = ὁμιλεῖν; Sab. מסוד place of speaker, oracle, HomZMG xlvi (1892), 529, who finds connexion with سَيِّدٌ lord, chief (and سَادَ be lord), properly speaker; NH = BH).
